parts.name: Badge
parts.description: A small count or dot on a navigation item, an icon button or a tab.

props.name: count
props.description: The number to show. Without it, the badge is a dot that only signals something new.

props.name: max
props.description: Counts above this show as `99+`.

props.name: label
props.description: What the badge means, read by assistive technology instead of the bare number, such as “3 unpaid invoices”. Leave it out only when the element the badge sits on already says it.

props.name: tone
props.description: Danger for things that need attention; accent for news.

parts.name: Button
parts.description: A native button. For navigation, use a link with the same class and data attributes instead: `<a class="sonar-button" data-variant="tonal" data-size="medium" href="…">`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. Filled for the one main action of a view, tonal for secondary actions, outlined and text for the rest.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium in forms, panels and dialogs; small in cards and toolbars.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the label. It is decorative: the label names the action.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Icon after the label, such as a chevron on a button that opens a menu.

parts.name: Card
parts.description: A card of the overview: a titled region with an optional summary figure, content and a way to the full page. The card is a section named by its title, so the overview reads as a list of landmarks.

props.name: title
props.description: The card’s name, which also names the region for assistive technology.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level of the title, to fit the page’s outline.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as a UnitMenu.

props.name: summary
props.description: The figure that sums the card up, under the title: a label and a value, such as Open total and 6,720 plt.

props.name: footer
props.description: The way out of the card, usually a CardLink to the full page.

props.name: size
props.description: Height in the overview grid: S, M, L or XL from the layout tokens. The header and footer stay put; content that does not fit scrolls between them. Without a size the card takes the height of its content.

props.name: label
props.description: The region’s accessible name, when the title alone would repeat on the page: the same card shown twice, as in “Orders, size S” and “Orders, size M”. By default the title names the region.

parts.name: CardScroll
parts.description: The part of a card’s content that gives way first when the card’s size leaves no room, such as a list of deliveries: it keeps its full height while it fits, and scrolls when it does not. The rest of the content stays in place.

props.name: label
props.description: What the list is, read when it takes focus to scroll: “Deliveries of May 12”.

parts.name: CardLink
parts.description: The link at the foot of a card to the page it summarizes, with the arrow in a filled circle.

props.name: children
props.description: Where it goes, as a verb phrase: Go to Orders.

parts.name: UnitMenu
parts.description: The unit a card’s figures are shown in, as a small pill that opens a menu. Changing it converts every figure in the card; it is the card’s only setting.

props.name: label
props.description: What the unit measures, read with the current value: “Unit: plt, Pallets”.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the unit shown, one of the options' values. The menu is always controlled.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; short: string; name: string }[]
props.description: The units to choose from: a short code, shown in caps on the pill and in the menu, and the full name, read with it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value of the unit chosen. The card converts its figures; the menu closes on its own.

parts.name: ChartLegend
parts.description: The key to a chart’s colors: a dot in each part’s tone, then its name.

props.name: items
props.description: One entry per color, in the order of the chart’s parts.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: A native checkbox, for choices that are submitted with a form or confirmed later.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being chosen.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of help, read after the label.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shown as a dash: some, not all, of the items it governs are checked. Clicking it checks it.

parts.name: DialogHost
parts.description: Holds the side panels and sheets written inside it, as a drawn app frame does, instead of placing them against the window.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown. The dialog is always controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the person closes it: the close button, Escape, a click outside, or a swipe down.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, which also names the dialog for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: One paragraph under the title, read when the dialog opens.

props.name: placement
props.description: Center for a decision; end for a side panel, such as the details of a delivery; bottom for a sheet on phones. On phones (under 600 px) a side panel becomes a sheet from the bottom, with a handle to swipe it down; tablets and desktops keep it at the side.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the rest of the page waits behind a scrim. A side panel that sits beside the overview, such as the details of a delivery or a new order, is not modal: no scrim, the page stays in view and the row it came from stays marked. It starts under the top bar (--sonar-dialog-top) and closes on Escape or a click outside.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the foot of the dialog, the main action last.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Name of the close button.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether a click on the scrim, or outside a panel that is not modal, closes it. Turn it off when closing would lose what the person typed.

parts.name: TextField
parts.description: A native text input with its label, help and error. Any input type that takes text: text, search, email, number…

props.name: label
props.description: The field’s name, always visible above it. Placeholders are examples, never labels.

props.name: description
props.description: Help shown under the field and read after the label.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. When present, the field is marked invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the field: medium (48 px) in forms, small (36 px) inside rows and panels, such as a quantity in a list.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the control, such as a search glass.

props.name: suffix
props.description: A unit after the value, inside the field, such as plt; it is read after the value.

parts.name: SelectField
parts.description: A native select with its label, help and error. The list is the platform’s own: the best picker on phones and full keyboard and screen reader support everywhere.

props.name: label
props.description: The field’s name, always visible above it. Placeholders are examples, never labels.

props.name: description
props.description: Help shown under the field and read after the label.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. When present, the field is marked invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the field: medium (48 px) in forms, small (36 px) inside rows and panels, such as a quantity in a list.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the control, such as a search glass.

props.name: children
props.description: The `<option>` and `<optgroup>` elements.

parts.name: IconButton
parts.description: A round button that shows only an icon.

props.name: label
props.description: What the button does, read by assistive technology. Pair the button with a Tooltip to show it on hover.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon. Decorative: the label names the action.

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard sits on any surface with no fill; the others follow the weights of Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium is a 40 px button; small is 32 px, for card headers and dense rows. Both keep a 48 px touch target.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Holds the menu’s open state.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The element that opens the menu. Pass a Button or an IconButton with `render`, so the trigger keeps its look.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The popup, positioned against the trigger and rendered at the end of the document.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the menu’s popup, after sonar-menu: a string, or a function of the menu’s state.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the menu opens on. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: How the menu lines up with its trigger along that side: start, center or end. A menu in a card header aligns to the end, so it opens inward.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance from the trigger, in pixels.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: An action.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the item, after its own: a string, or a function of its state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Text at the end of the row, such as a shortcut or a count.

props.name: tone
props.description: Danger for destructive actions: the label turns red, and the action should still be confirmed or undoable.

parts.name: Separator
parts.description: A rule between groups of items.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the separator, after its own: a string, or a function of its state.

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Items that belong together, named by a GroupLabel.

parts.name: GroupLabel
parts.description: The name of a group, read when focus enters it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the group label, after its own: a string, or a function of its state.

parts.name: RadioGroup
parts.description: A set of items where exactly one is chosen, such as the unit figures are shown in.

parts.name: RadioItem
parts.description: One choice in a RadioGroup, with a check when chosen.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the radio item, after its own: a string, or a function of its state.

parts.name: Notice
parts.description: A message inside the page, next to what it is about. It stays until the situation changes; for feedback on an action that just happened, use a toast. Add `role="status"` or `role="alert"` when the notice appears while the person is working, so it is announced.

props.name: tone
props.description: Info for news and tips, success for a finished task, warning for something to check, danger for a problem.

props.name: title
props.description: A few words in bold before the message.

props.name: children
props.description: The message, one or two sentences.

props.name: action
props.description: One action at the end, such as a Button with `variant="text"`.

parts.name: RingChart
parts.description: Parts of a whole as a ring of ticks: the donut of the Inventory card.

props.name: segments
props.description: The parts of the whole, in order around the ring: each with a label, a value and a chart tone.

props.name: label
props.description: What the ring measures, read before its parts: “Inventory”.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Ticks around the ring. Fewer read as coarser; the dashboard uses 96.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes a value for the chart’s accessible name: “On hold 1,420 plt”. Plain numbers when left out.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the parts run from twelve o’clock. Counterclockwise puts the first part on the left, beside a label set on that side, as in the Inventory card.

props.name: children
props.description: Content in the hole of the ring, such as the total.

parts.name: ScrollArea
parts.description: Content that scrolls inside a fixed height, as the product’s lists do: no scrollbar of the system, a fade at each edge that has more, and a thin indicator that shows while it scrolls and fades out a second after. The indicator never covers the content or its buttons. While it scrolls the area is a named group that takes focus, so the keyboard scrolls it; when everything fits it is plain content and adds no tab stop.

props.name: label
props.description: What the content is, read when the area takes focus to scroll: “Invoices”, “System notifications”.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Where the indicator runs. Outside: in the padding beside the area, 4 to 6 px past its end, as in the product’s cards and panels, where there is padding to hold it. Inside: in a lane of its own at the end of the area, which the content never reaches, for an area with no padding beside it.

parts.name: SearchField
parts.description: A search field with its results in a list under it.

props.name: label
props.description: What is searched, read by assistive technology: “Search orders, deliveries and invoices”.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Whether the label is drawn above the field. In a top bar the icon and the placeholder say what it is.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example of what to type, never a label.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. The field is always controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text as people type or clear the field; not when a result is chosen.

props.name: items
props.description: The results for the current text, or suggestions while the field is empty.

props.name: itemToString
props.description: The text of an item: its key, and what is announced when it is highlighted.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Draws one result, usually as a SearchResult.

props.name: onItemChoose
props.description: Called when a result is chosen, by click or with Enter. Return true to keep the list open with the field focused, as when a suggestion fills the field with its text.

props.name: status
props.description: A line at the top of the list, announced politely: how the text was read, or that the search is running.

props.name: busy
props.description: While the results are on their way: the field says so and the list keeps the previous results out of reach.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when the text has no results.

props.name: busyIcon
props.description: Icon shown while busy, instead of the magnifier.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium in a top bar; small inside a card or a panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the field’s wrapper, after sonar-search.

props.name: variant
props.description: `field`: the outlined box. `top-bar`: the product’s top-bar search (v38): no box of its own, it fills the app bar’s search pill (39 px), with a 22 px icon, 12 px text and an 18 px clear mark. On touch screens its text is 16 px drawn at three quarters, so it looks the same and iOS does not zoom in.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the magnifier, such as the app’s own icon font glyph.

props.name: clearIcon
props.description: Replaces the clear mark.

props.name: statusIcon
props.description: Drawn before the status line as the 28 px accent circle: what reads the text (an AI sparkle).

props.name: popupClassName
props.description: Classes added to the results popup, to place or size it from the app.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the results line up with the field.

props.name: popupWidth
props.description: Width of the results: `anchor` is the field’s width, `auto` the field’s width but at least 320 px, or any CSS length (`calc(100vw - 24px)`).

parts.name: SearchResult
parts.description: One row of results: an icon, a title, a line under it and something at the end.

props.name: icon
props.description: What kind of thing it is, as an icon: a truck for a delivery, a receipt for an invoice.

props.name: title
props.description: The result itself, on one line: a code and its key figure, such as “04-127C 12 items · 6 plt”.

props.name: description
props.description: A second line: the kind of result and when it is.

props.name: trailing
props.description: At the end of the row, such as a Status dot.

parts.name: SegmentedControl
parts.description: A choice of one among a few, drawn as a row of segments. Native radios underneath: arrow keys move the choice, and the control works in forms without JavaScript.

props.name: legend
props.description: What is being chosen, such as “Unit”. Always present for assistive technology; drawn unless `hideLegend`.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Hides the legend from view while keeping it for assistive technology, when the options explain themselves.

props.name: options
props.description: Two to five options. More than that is a select.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared by the radios, so the choice is submitted with a form. A unique name is made when it is left out.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value, for a controlled control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value chosen at first, for an uncontrolled control.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when the choice changes.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show icons only. Every option still needs a label.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium for toolbars and forms; small inside a card header, beside its title.

parts.name: Status
parts.description: The state of an order, a delivery or an invoice.

props.name: tone
props.description: What the state means. Color never carries it alone: the text always names it.

props.name: appearance
props.description: A dot beside the text, for rows and lists; or a chip, for headers and for containers, where colored text would not reach 4.5:1.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Only the dot shows; the state stays in the text for assistive technology. For dense rows where a tooltip or the row’s details name the state, as in the overview’s calendars.

props.name: children
props.description: The state in words: Delivered, Delayed, Due today.

parts.name: Switch
parts.description: A native checkbox with the switch role: it works without JavaScript, in forms and with every assistive technology. Use it for settings that apply at once; for a choice that is submitted later, use Checkbox.

props.name: label
props.description: What the switch turns on.

props.name: description
props.description: One line on the effect, read after the label.

parts.name: TickBar
parts.description: A proportion as a row of fine ticks.

props.name: segments
props.description: The parts of a whole, in order. Each takes its share of the width.

props.name: label
props.description: What the bar measures, read before its parts: “May orders”.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats values for the accessible description.

parts.name: ToastProvider
parts.description: Feedback on something that just happened, on the inverse surface at the bottom of the window, with at most one action. One toast at a time: a new one replaces the last. Base UI announces it, pauses it while hovered or focused, and lets it be swiped away.

props.name: children
props.description: The part of the app that can show toasts, usually all of it. useToast works anywhere inside.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Time a toast stays, in milliseconds. One with an action stays twice as long, so there is time to use it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Name of the close button.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the region the toasts appear in. Give each provider its own when a page has more than one.

props.name: inset
props.type: { left?: string; right?: string; bottom?: string }
props.description: Where the toasts sit, as CSS lengths: `left` and `right` bound the area they centre in (such as the main area, right of a sidebar), `bottom` lifts them above a footer or a bottom app bar. The window’s safe area is added to `bottom`.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Whether toasts carry a close button. One with an action can still be swiped away or wait for its timeout.

parts.name: Tooltip
parts.description: A short label on the inverse surface, shown on hover and focus. Wrap groups of triggers in TooltipProvider so that, once one tooltip is open, moving to the next shows it without the delay.

props.name: content
props.description: The text shown. Short: a name or a hint, never something the person must read to continue.

props.name: children
props.description: The element it describes, usually an IconButton. It must be focusable, so keyboard users get the tooltip too.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the element the tooltip opens on. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: delay
props.description: Time the pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens, in milliseconds. Keyboard focus opens it at once.

parts.name: TooltipProvider
parts.description: Shares the open delay between tooltips, so moving along a toolbar does not wait at every button.

parts.name: TrendChart
parts.description: A daily series as a line, with its running total dotted against a second axis. The legend turns each series off and on; the pointer, a finger or the arrow keys show the values of a day.

props.name: label
props.description: One sentence that sums the chart up, read first: “Daily shipments in May, 11,940 pallets in total”.

props.name: categories
props.description: The label of each point along the x axis, such as the days of the month.

props.name: series
props.description: The series drawn as a solid line. Missing points (null) leave a gap: days still to come.

props.name: cumulative
props.description: A second series drawn dotted against its own axis on the right: the running total of the first.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of the values, after each figure in the tooltip.

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Indices of the categories labeled on the x axis.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart in pixels, axes included. The width follows its container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes added to the chart’s root element, after sonar-trend-chart.
